name: career-coach
description: Evidence-grounded career direction, professional-development planning and tracking, bidirectional opportunity fit and due diligence, interview preparation, and resume tailoring from verified evidence.

interface.longDescription: Clarify career direction, plan and track professional development, evaluate opportunities from both sides, prepare evidence-based interviews, and tailor resumes without inventing or overstating evidence.
defaultPrompt: Help me clarify what I should target next in my career.
Turn a career priority into a practical development plan and next actions.
Evaluate whether this opportunity fits me and whether I fit it.
Prepare evidence-based answers for my upcoming interview.
Tailor my resume to this role using only supported facts.
